audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose was even-across-the-board while the two level layers disagreed for five of seven rows (full said Skill, content said Brand).
audit.why: Brand's Sear is 1050 range on an 8s cooldown at rank 1 and Pillar of Flame is 900 range; Azir has to stand at soldier range to farm, so the early lane is Brand's. Azir's win rate edge (53.74%) comes from the Nashor's/late curve, not from lane.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-5 Brand, Level 6 Skill, first item and 2+ items Azir, with both layers stating the same thing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes referenced 'Liandry's/Shurelya's-Sheen components' as the first-item spike; report[8] on the same page rushes Nashor's Tooth.
audit.why: Placeholder itemisation contradicts the page's own build. Azir's spike is Nashor's Tooth into Sorcerer's; Brand's are level 6 (Pyroclasm, 100s at rank 1) and max Blaze stacks.
audit.corrected: Nashor's Tooth named as the inflection; Brand's level 6 spike stated as Pyroclasm's five-bounce chain rather than a fabricated ability.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text used the fabricated name 'Ares of Blaze' for Brand's R, and the cooldown field contained no digits at all.
audit.why: Riot's kit names Brand's R Pyroclasm; his stun only exists while Blaze is applied, so the decisive interaction is denying the first proc (Conflagration 13/12/11/10/9, Pillar of Flame 10/9.5/9/8.5/8) rather than dodging Sear itself.
audit.corrected: Pyroclasm named; Sear's stun conditional stated with real cooldowns; Azir's E (22s at rank 1) framed as the one escape that gates standing at soldier range.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E/R text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number (catalogue defect 3), and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second' Sear window.
audit.why: Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 — a fifteen-second figure is wrong by roughly double.
audit.corrected: Real Sear, Pillar of Flame, Conflagration and Shifting Sands cooldowns written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text claimed his combo 'chunks 50%+' with no source (catalogue defect 6).
audit.why: The kit gives one real multiplier: Pillar of Flame deals 25% extra to ablaze targets. Everything else is an invented magnitude.
audit.corrected: Replaced the invented percentage with the sourced 25% and the ablaze ordering.

edits.before: Ares of Blaze gives him a delayed AoE detonation that punishes you for standing near your own soldiers when he all-ins with Sear stun.
edits.after: Pyroclasm bounces up to five times between him and nearby enemies, stacking Blaze to max and slowing you — never take it grouped.

edits.before: Brand can hard-zone your soldier casts with Sear-Pillar-Conflagration combos that chunk 50%+ if you're caught out of position near minions.
edits.after: Brand hard-zones your soldier line: Conflagration off a minion sets you ablaze, then Sear stuns and Pillar of Flame lands 25% harder on you.

edits.before: Once you finish Liandry's/Shurelya's-Sheen components your poke trades and wave clear finally out-scale his burst combo.
edits.after: Once Nashor's Tooth lands, soldier autos out-DPS his combo and the gap between Pillar of Flame casts becomes your trade window.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shifting Sands for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Sear (Stun): 8s at rank 1, 6s maxed, and it only stuns while Blaze is on you — so dodging Pillar of Flame (10s) and Conflagration (13s) disarms the stun before it is cast. - Shifting Sands is 22s at rank 1: while it is down you have no right to stand at soldier range.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by setting Blaze off a minion with Conflagration, stunning you with Sear, and detonating three stacks.

edits.before: Ahead, siege: crash waves with soldier autos, take every plate, and rotate to river with R held — your wall converts even fights into massacres.
edits.after: Ahead, take the wave off him: shove with soldier autos so he last-hits under tower, plate, then roam — Brand walks, so he follows late or not at all.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.
edits.after: Carry by making fights long: his damage is one 100-second Pyroclasm and a 6-second stun; your soldiers keep hitting after both are spent.

edits.before: If Brand opens the score, reset expectations and respect Sear (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: If Brand opens the score, stop giving him Blaze: farm the back of the wave so Conflagration cannot spread to you, and never step up with Shifting Sands on cooldown. Your only job is Nashor's on time.

edits.before: Best wave: a controlled slow push you crash with soldier autos — the crash funds your roam, your plates, and your scuttle-fight presence. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with your E down — walking up to reset it is the most-ganked walk in mid lane. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.
edits.after: Best wave: short and moving toward you — Pillar of Flame clears a stacked wave in one cast, so slow-pushing hands him free Blaze procs on you. Worst wave: frozen at his tower with Shifting Sands down; that walk is where Sear finds you with minions behind you. Crash timing: crash into his cooldowns, then reset or roam — never linger at 900 range.

edits.before: Brand burns Sear (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Brand throws Sear at a minion — six to eight seconds with no stun in his kit.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Brand

edits.before: W a soldier behind the wave and farm THROUGH it — your auto range is the soldier's range. Don't poke yet; sand costs mana.
edits.after: Sear outranges everything you own at level 1 at 1050. W a soldier behind the wave, farm through it, eat the chip and do not answer.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Brand

edits.before: Two soldiers up means a real trade: W-Q the drag-through and step back. The poke is free only when his engage is down.
edits.after: Two soldiers let you drag a Q through him, but Conflagration into Sear still wins the exchange — trade only once his Q is spent.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Brand

edits.before: E completes the safety net — you now have the shield-dash out. Greedier soldier placements are allowed, not encouraged.
edits.after: Shifting Sands is your safety net, but 22 seconds covers one mistake. Blaze sits on you most of the wave, so level 3 is his.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Brand

edits.before: Nashor's components arrive and the soldier DPS starts to sting. Drag Qs through Brand on every last-hit he takes.
edits.after: Nashor's components sting, but Pillar of Flame is down to 9 seconds and shoves you off the wave — farm it, don't contest.

edits.before: Emperor's Divide online — the dive insurance and the insec flip. With R up you win every 2v2 your jungler joins.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide online — dive insurance on 120 seconds. With R up the 2v2 flips your way; without it he out-pokes you.

edits.before: Brand
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Your level 6 Emperor's Divide creates disengage/peel that neutralizes his kill pressure, tipping the lane
edits.after: Emperor's Divide answers his Pyroclasm commit, but a 120-second wall only buys parity, not control of the lane

edits.before: Item power spikes (Liandry's/Shurelya's) let your wave clear and range finally outpace his burst
edits.after: Nashor's Tooth turns soldier autos into real DPS and your clear finally outpaces one Pillar of Flame

notes: Level chart disagreed across layers on rows 0-4 (full: Skill x5; content: Brand x5). Aligned to Brand for levels 1 through 4-5 and Skill at level 6, with every why rewritten in the same proposal to match the verdict; rows 5-6 already agreed on Azir. Left phases[N].rating untouched: the scale is not consistent between matchup files, so a rating flip could invert the meaning. 'Ares of Blaze' was a fabricated R name and is now Pyroclasm. Did not touch the Wind Wall-class flag on Brand's projectiles: Azir has no projectile-blocking ability, so it never applies here. Emperor's Divide creating terrain that stops Pyroclasm bounces or Sear mid-flight is NOT in Riot's text — left unasserted.
